text:
leo: quick thought: a compact toolbar above the roles list that groups Invite, Members, Audit, and View (compact/comfy) toggles. goal: surface primary actions without inspecting each row.

anish: nice. would toolbar actions apply to filtered results or selected rows? need to be explicit.

leo: toolbar should operate on the current filter set by default (search/filters). if user selects specific rows, toolbar switches to act on selection. microcopy: 'Apply to filtered roles (10)' vs 'Apply to selected (3)'.

tess: accessibility: toolbar must be reachable as a single landmark (role="toolbar") and each control needs clear aria-labels. when switching from filtered->selection mode announce via aria-live: "Toolbar now targeting 3 selected roles".

sam: product constraint: SSO enforcement is org-level. if we include an SSO indicator in the toolbar it should be read-only and open org settings. avoid showing a toggle here.

design-bot: mock: https://figma.redwood/toolbar/compact shows an SSO pill that reads "SSO required" when enabled, else hidden. Also includes a small kebab menu for batch actions (export, audit-export).

tess: keyboard interactions: the kebab menu should open with Enter/Space and the menu items navigable with Arrow keys. Ensure Escape closes menu and returns focus to kebab. Also provide shortcut hint (.) for quick open.

anish: audit export: if toolbar triggers an audit export for the filtered set, show a confirm dialog listing estimated rows and a warning about export size. handle as async job with toast and link to downloads.

leo: UX nit: when toolbar is in selection mode, also show a clear 'X' to clear selection and revert to filtered mode. small animation to avoid jarring layout shift.

tess: SR pattern: toolbar summary should have a concise aria-label like "Role actions toolbar, targeting 10 roles" and a visually-hidden region with details for screen reader users. link examples: role="toolbar" aria-label="Role actions toolbar" aria-describedby="toolbar-announce-10".

sam: action items: design-bot: add compact toolbar mock + SSO pill variant and export modal; tess: write aria-live wording and keyboard flows; anish: prototype selection->toolbar state transitions; leo: add copy for confirm dialogs and export toasts. review Thursday 2pm. :thumbsup:
